results.title: Seagate vs. Western Digital: Which HDD Leader Should Investors Pick?
results.summary: HDD market is a duopoly: WDC ~45% share vs Seagate ~42%. Competition shifted to who can scale 40TB+ HAMR drives fastest. Both report 2026 capacity fully committed.

results.title: Western Digital (WDC) 2026 Feature: The Pure-Play Pivot to AI Storage Dominance
results.summary: WDC repositioned as pure-play AI storage company after SanDisk spin-off. Both WDC and Seagate benefit from NAND shortage driving enterprise SSD price hikes 30-60%.

results.title: The Storage Supercycle: Western Digital and Seagate Surge as Micron's 'Blowout' Earnings Redefine the AI Landscape
results.summary: Memory manufacturers reallocating capacity to HBM, causing NAND supply plunge and price hikes. WDC and Seagate co-benefiting from storage supercycle driven by AI data center build-out.

results.title: Western Digital Cuts Final Ties with SanDisk: $3.1 Billion Exit Sends Shares Tumbling
results.summary: WDC sold remaining SanDisk stake for $3.1B in Feb 2026. Shares initially fell but allowed WDC to focus purely on HDD and become direct AI-infrastructure play.
